tweaks.name: Clean User Temporary Files & App Cache
tweaks.description: Cleans only unlocked user temporary files older than 7 days. Personal documents, downloads, browser profiles, and passwords are not touched.

tweaks.name: Clean Old Windows System Temp Files
tweaks.description: Cleans only Windows\Temp files older than 7 days. Prefetch and Windows Update caches are preserved.

tweaks.name: Clean Crash Dumps & DirectX Shader Cache
tweaks.description: Cleans selected Windows Error Reporting crash dumps and Direct3D shader cache files. Windows Update download files are preserved.

tweaks.name: Disable NTFS Last-Access Disk Write Overhead
tweaks.description: Sets NtfsDisableLastAccessUpdate=1 and disables 8.3 legacy short-name creation to reduce SSD wear and speed up folder loading.

tweaks.name: Verify SSD TRIM & Optimize File System Memory Cache
tweaks.description: Ensures SSD TRIM (DisableDeleteNotify=0) is active and sets NtfsMemoryUsage=2 for faster file system caching.

tweaks.name: Flush Idle RAM Working Sets & Tune SvcHost Grouping
tweaks.description: Matches SvcHostSplitThresholdInKB to physical RAM (reducing 70+ svchost processes) and trims idle background process memory.

tweaks.name: Disable Network Throttling & Flush Stale DNS Cache
tweaks.description: Sets NetworkThrottlingIndex=FFFFFFFF, SystemResponsiveness=10 for smooth video/audio streaming, and flushes DNS cache.

tweaks.name: Enable Hardware GPU Scheduling & Disable GameDVR Capture
tweaks.description: Requests Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling and disables background GameDVR capture. Compatibility varies by GPU driver; revert if graphics issues appear.

tweaks.name: Zero Startup Delay (Instant Desktop Boot)
tweaks.description: Removes the artificial 10-second Windows desktop startup delay (StartupDelayInMSec = 0) so apps load immediately.

tweaks.name: Fast Shutdown & Auto-Close Hung Apps (2000ms)
tweaks.description: Shortens Windows shutdown timeouts and enables automatic closure of hung apps. This may close applications before they save work; review the warning and save all files first.

tweaks.name: Disable Non-Essential Startup Bloat (OneDrive/Teams/Cortana)
tweaks.description: Disables known non-essential auto-start entries (OneDrive, Teams, Cortana, Spotify) while preserving audio, touchpad, and security drivers.

tweaks.name: Stop Microsoft Edge Startup Boost & Background RAM Drain
tweaks.description: Stops Microsoft Edge from running background processes after the browser is closed.

tweaks.name: Restrict Background Store Apps Activity
tweaks.description: Prevents unused Microsoft Store apps from waking up in the background and consuming RAM and battery.

tweaks.name: Disable Diagnostic & Telemetry Background Tasks
tweaks.description: Reduces Windows diagnostic data collection (AllowTelemetry=0) and disables background Customer Experience tasks.

tweaks.name: Stop Heavy Background RAM Services (SysMain, Search Indexing, Maps)
tweaks.description: Sets SysMain (Superfetch), Windows Search Indexing, and MapsBroker to Manual/Stopped for 2GB/4GB RAM laptops to eliminate 100% disk/RAM spikes.

tweaks.name: Instant Menu, Mouse & Taskbar End-Task Speed
tweaks.description: Sets MenuShowDelay to 20ms, enables Taskbar Right-Click 'End Task', opens File Explorer to This PC, and shows file extensions.

tweaks.name: Lag-Free File Explorer & Block Explorer Sync Ads
tweaks.description: Disables Explorer automatic network crawling (NoNetCrawling=1), hides OneDrive sync banner ads, and sets HungAppTimeout=2000ms.

tweaks.name: Disable Heavy Window Transparency & Blur Effects
tweaks.description: Turns off heavy acrylic blur and window transparency to free up integrated GPU memory while keeping crisp font smoothing.

tweaks.name: Ultra-Light Visual Mode (2GB/4GB RAM Maximum Speed)
tweaks.description: Disables non-essential desktop animations and fade effects while keeping ClearType smooth fonts readable.

tweaks.name: Block Auto-Installing Bloatware & Start/Lock Screen Ads
tweaks.description: Disables Windows Consumer Features, Start Menu suggestions, Lock Screen tips, and Settings promotional banners.

tweaks.name: Disable Copilot, Recall, Widgets & Start Menu Bing Search
tweaks.description: Disables slow web results in Start Menu search, hides the RAM-heavy Taskbar Widgets feed, and disables Windows Recall/Copilot.

tweaks.name: Disable Activity History, Advertising ID & WPBT BIOS Bloat
tweaks.description: Disables Activity History uploads and Advertising ID. Also blocks WPBT execution, which may affect some OEM-provided platform components; review before applying.

tweaks.name: Stop Connected Telemetry & Error Reporting Services
tweaks.description: Sets DiagTrack, dmwappushservice, and WerSvc to Manual/Stopped to eliminate background telemetry disk and network spikes.

tweaks.name: Remove Unused Xbox & Gaming Overlay Bloatware
tweaks.description: Removes non-essential Xbox consumer overlays (XboxGamingOverlay, XboxApp, Xbox.TCUI, XboxSpeechToTextOverlay) to free RAM.

tweaks.name: Remove Promotional & Consumer Bloatware Apps
tweaks.description: Removes preinstalled promotional apps (BingNews, BingWeather, SolitaireCollection, Clipchamp, FeedbackHub, GetHelp, Todos).

tweaks.name: Maximum Optional Store App Cleanup (2GB/4GB RAM Light Mode)
tweaks.description: Removes additional optional consumer packages (Maps, People, ZuneVideo, MixedReality, 3DViewer, QuickAssist) while keeping Store, Calculator, Photos, and Notepad intact.

tweaks.name: Reduce / Disable Windows Defender Real-Time Monitoring (2GB/4GB Opt-In)
tweaks.description: Applies policy to disable Defender real-time monitoring on ultra-low RAM PCs (only when explicitly confirmed; respects Tamper Protection).

tweaks.name: Activate High-Responsiveness Power & CPU Priority
tweaks.description: Enables Windows Game Mode hardware scheduling, sets Win32PrioritySeparation for responsive foreground apps, and checks disk space.

tweaks.name: Stop Modern Standby Battery Drain & Network Wake
tweaks.description: Prevents network activity during Modern Standby so laptops do not overheat or drain battery while closed.

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Update P2P Bandwidth Sharing
tweaks.description: Sets Delivery Optimization DODownloadMode=0 so Windows never uses your internet or disk to upload updates to other PCs.

tweaks.name: Windows Update - Manual Control Only (Notify Before Download)
tweaks.description: Configures Windows Update policy (AUOptions=2) so updates never download or restart automatically during work, while manual checking stays available.

tweaks.name: Suppress Automatic Windows & Store Background Updates
tweaks.description: Configures NoAutoUpdate=1 and Store AutoDownload=2 to stop background update CPU/disk usage on low-resource laptops (manual check remains available).
